name: Cyclonic Rift
reason: Overloaded at 7: bounces every nonland permanent your opponents control, at instant speed. Game Changer.

name: Farewell
reason: Exile any mix of creatures, artifacts, enchantments and graveyards. Game Changer.

name: Austere Command
reason: 6 mana: pick two of creatures, artifacts, enchantments and lands... the right two every time.

name: Ruinous Ultimatum
reason: 7 mana: destroy every nonland permanent your opponents control.

name: Pernicious Deed
reason: Destroy every artifact, creature and enchantment with mana value X or less, when you choose.

name: Merciless Eviction
reason: 6 mana: exile every permanent of one type; you pick which.

name: Hour of Revelation
reason: Destroy all nonland permanents; costs less with a full board.

name: Nevinyrral's Disk
reason: Artifact you crack to destroy all creatures, artifacts and enchantments.

name: Oblivion Stone
reason: Artifact you crack to exile everything nonland without a fate counter.

name: Cleansing Nova
reason: Destroy all creatures, or all artifacts and enchantments.

name: Planar Cleansing
reason: 6 mana: destroy all nonland permanents.

name: Toxic Deluge
reason: 3 mana: pay life for -X/-X on every creature; gets past indestructible.

reason: Often costs 1: 13 damage to each creature.

name: Damnation
reason: 4-mana sorcery: destroy all creatures; they can't regenerate.

name: Wrath of God
reason: 4 mana: destroy all creatures; they can't regenerate.

name: Day of Judgment
reason: 4 mana: destroy all creatures.

name: Vanquish the Horde
reason: Usually 2 to 4 mana: destroy all creatures.

name: In Garruk's Wake
reason: 9 mana: destroy every creature and planeswalker your opponents control.

name: Damn
reason: 2-mana removal, or overload at 4 to destroy all creatures.

name: Sunfall
reason: 5 mana: exile all creatures and leave yourself a body.

name: Crux of Fate
reason: 5 mana: destroy all Dragons or all non-Dragons.

name: Black Sun's Zenith
reason: X: -1/-1 counters on every creature, then it shuffles back to use again.

name: Terminus
reason: Miracle for {W}: tuck every creature into its owner's library.

name: Doomskar
reason: Foretell it, then wrath for 3 later.

name: Massacre Wurm
reason: 6-mana creature: opponents' creatures get -2/-2 and each death costs them 2 life.

name: Plague Wind
reason: 9 mana: destroy every creature you don't control.

name: Extinction Event
reason: Exile all creatures with even or odd mana value, your pick.

name: Rout
reason: Instant wrath for 7, or a 5-mana sorcery.

name: Decree of Pain
reason: Destroy all creatures and draw a card for each one you lose.

name: Fumigate
reason: Destroy all creatures and gain life for each.

name: Settle the Wreckage
reason: Instant: exile every attacking creature.

name: Mizzium Mortars
reason: Overloaded at 6: 4 damage to every creature you don't control.

name: Kindred Dominance
reason: 7 mana: destroy all creatures not of the type you name.

name: Hallowed Burial
reason: 5 mana: tuck every creature into its owner's library.

name: Massacre Girl
reason: Body that chains -1/-1 through the board.

name: Deadly Tempest
reason: Destroy all creatures; each player loses life for theirs.

name: Starstorm
reason: Instant X damage to each creature; cycles when you don't need it.

name: Anger of the Gods
reason: 3 damage to each creature, exiling what dies.

name: Dusk // Dawn
reason: Destroy creatures with power 3 or more, or recast small ones later.

name: Sweltering Suns
reason: 3 damage to each creature; cycles.

name: Evacuation
reason: Instant: bounce every creature.

name: Vandalblast
reason: Overloaded at 5: destroy every artifact you don't control.

name: Bane of Progress
reason: Destroy all artifacts and enchantments every time it or another creature you control... dies.

name: Tranquility
reason: 3 mana: destroy all enchantments.

name: Shatterstorm
reason: 3 mana: destroy all artifacts.

reason: X: every creature gets -X/-X, and it drains opponents as their creatures die.

name: Council's Judgment
reason: Single-target removal by vote; listed under targeted removal.

reason: Kills one creature unless you've already dealt damage around the board this turn.

reason: Overloaded, 1 damage to each creature you don't control for two mana. Only kills X/1s.

name: Spring Cleaning
reason: Kills one enchantment; the clash for the rest is a coin flip at best.

name: Final Showdown
reason: Instant-speed Wrath for six mana, seven to keep your best creature.

name: Glyph of Doom
reason: Needs a Wall that blocked; not a real wipe.

name: Glyph of Reincarnation
reason: Needs a Wall that blocked; not a real wipe.

name: Siren's Call
reason: Forces one player's attack and kills what stayed home. Rarely hits much.

name: Ghostway
reason: Blinks your own creatures; protection, not a wipe.

name: Savage Alliance
reason: Four mana to ping one opponent's board and shoot a creature. Kills only small creatures.

name: Iroh's Demonstration
reason: Two mana: 1 damage to every creature your opponents control, or 4 to one. Small-creature sweeper.

name: Simoon
reason: Pings one opponent's creatures for 1. Kills only X/1s.

name: Smash to Dust
reason: Two-mana flex: kill an artifact, or ping every creature your opponents control.

name: Winds of Abandon
reason: Overloaded, exiles every creature you don't control for six. They all get basics, though.

name: Planar Guide
reason: Blinks every creature; only tokens and auras stay gone.

name: Blot Out the Sky
reason: At X=6 or more, eight mana for six fliers and a wipe of every noncreature, nonland permanent.

name: Make an Example
reason: Each opponent loses one of two piles they make. Four mana, one-sided, about half their creatures.
